collaborations.title: My collaborations
collaborations.intro: Client registrations and viewing requests with other agencies, in both directions, and where they stand.
collaborations.load: The collaborations could not be loaded. Try again.

register.title: Register a client
register.explain: The first valid registration of a client for this target wins. The owner sees your agency and the dates, never the client.
register.own: This belongs to your agency, so there is nobody to register a client with.
register.noTerms: You can register the client, but a viewing cannot be requested until the owner publishes commission terms.
register.find: Find a contact by e-mail or phone
register.findNone: No contact has this e-mail or phone.
register.findInvalid: Enter a full e-mail address or phone number.
register.noRecent: You have no contacts with an e-mail or phone yet. Find one above or create one.
register.recentFailed: Your contacts could not be loaded. Find one by e-mail or phone, or reload the page.

request.note: Requesting accepts the target’s current commission terms for your agency.
request.open: A viewing is already open for this client.

actions.acceptNote: Accepting also accepts the commission terms for your agency. They cannot change afterwards.
actions.declineConfirm: Decline this viewing? This closes the request.
actions.rescheduleNote: Proposing a time also accepts the commission terms for your agency.
actions.cancelConfirm: Cancel this viewing? This closes it for both agencies.

hints.BIND_LISTING: Only your agency’s admins or the listing’s agent can accept or propose a time, because that binds the agency to the commission.
hints.BIND_DEVELOPMENT: Only your agency’s admins can accept or propose a time for a development, because that binds the agency to the commission.
hints.OUTCOME_LATER: The outcome can be recorded after the scheduled time.
hints.LAPSED: This proposal was not answered in time and is about to close.

blocked.CLIENT_MODE: Collaborations are not available in Client Mode.
blocked.IMPERSONATING: Support staff acting as a member cannot register clients or answer viewings, because that binds the agency.
blocked.ROLE: Your role cannot register clients or answer viewings.
blocked.UNVERIFIED: Only verified agencies can register clients and answer viewings on the network.
blocked.LOCKED: Your agency has to share more listings on the network before it can register clients or request viewings. You can still answer what is already open.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot do this: it takes a member of a verified agency with the right role.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Your agency has to wait before trying again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the fields and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This form was already sent with other values. Open the page again and retry.
errors.NO_EMAIL_OR_PHONE: This contact has no e-mail or phone, which a registration needs. Add one to the contact first.
errors.CONTACT_NOT_FOUND: That contact no longer exists in your agency.
errors.REGISTRATION_CONFLICT: Another agency already has a valid registration of this client for this target, so yours was not recorded.
errors.REGISTRATION_TARGET_NOT_FOUND: This listing or development is not available on the network any more, or belongs to your agency.
errors.REGISTRATION_NOT_FOUND: This registration is not valid any more. Register the client again.
errors.PAST: Choose a time in the future.
errors.AFTER_REGISTRATION: Choose a time before the registration ends.
errors.VIEWING_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: This viewing request does not exist any more.
errors.VIEWING_REQUEST_OPEN: This client already has an open viewing for this target. Answer or cancel that one first.
errors.VIEWING_TERMS_INCOMPLETE: The owner has not published a commission and split for this target, so a viewing cannot be requested yet. Ask the owner to complete them.
errors.STATE_EXPIRED: This proposal expired before it was answered.
errors.STATE_NOT_AWAITING: The other agency has to answer this proposal, not yours.
errors.STATE_TOO_LATE: The scheduled time has passed, so it cannot be moved. Record the outcome instead.
errors.STATE_NOT_SCHEDULED: The outcome can only be recorded for a scheduled viewing.
errors.STATE_TOO_EARLY: The outcome can be recorded after the scheduled time.
errors.STATE_CHANGED: This viewing has just changed. Check where it stands and try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.
errors.NETWORK_GIVE_TO_GET_LOCKED: Your agency has to share more listings before it can start new collaborations. It can still answer the ones already open.

done.registered: Client registered. You can now request a viewing below.
done.alreadyRegistered: Your agency had already registered this client for this target, and that registration is still valid. Nothing new was recorded.
done.viewingRequested: Viewing requested. The owner has been told.
done.rescheduled: New time proposed. The other agency has to answer it.

board.title: Network board
board.intro: Buyer requests, property offers, distressed sales and developer announcements from agencies on the network. Reply to start a chat with the poster; subscribe to be told about matching posts.

post.title: Post to the network
post.bodyHelp: No phone numbers or e-mail addresses: contact happens in the chat.

subscriptions.title: My subscriptions
subscriptions.intro: You get a notification when a new post matches a subscription.
subscriptions.name: Name

savedSearches.title: Saved searches
savedSearches.intro: Save a search and get an alert when a listing that matches it comes on the market, drops its price or is back on the market — in your notifications and your e-mail summary.
